title: A MOTEL OFF THE 5 — JULY 16, 1988 — 6:40 AM

a.speaker: narration
a.text: She wakes with the pistol pointed at the television. The test pattern hums.

b.speaker: narration
b.text: The phone is ringing. It has been ringing for a while.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: Bad dreams, Miss Moreno? Good. It means you're finally method acting.

e.speaker: voice
e.text: Season two starts in 1990. We've already cast the others. A girl at an arcade. A cop who doesn't sleep. You'll love them. You'll kill some of them.

g.speaker: voice
g.text: You're the reason they're watching. Rest. We'll call you when we need the star.

h.speaker: narration
h.text: On the corkboard she builds that week, the first Polaroid is a girl in a harlequin jacket at the Galaxy Palace. Somebody has already written THE FOOL under it.
